contracts.name: get
contracts.wrapper_application_order: Evaluate wrapper expressions at definition; apply wrappers from the last listed expression toward the first. Their authorization, regional dispatch, caching and optional-capability behavior must be bound separately.
contracts.module_context_requirement: Bind referenced module values, imports, class inheritance and shared state before invoking the operation body.
